pages.text: This 1.12 compatibility ritual uses a bound Djinni book, sugar, a glass bottle, a dandelion and wheat. It waits for a player to kill a chicken near the golden bowl. No bee nest or cursed honey is required beforehand. The summoned local Possessed Bee $()

poisons targets and calls allies when hurt. Killing it drops $(item)Cursed Honey$() for orange impure chalk.$(br2)A nearby bee nest attracts a bee that has no attack target; it disappears when it enters the nest.
